question: Will Kim meet Trump this year, yes or no?
hook_lines: KIM CROSSES NEW BRIDGE INTO CHINA

lines.text: Kim Jong Un has crossed into China over the new Yalu River bridge, South Korea says.
South Korean officials say China's premier, Li Qiang, met him in Dandong.
His last known trip to China was in September last year.
The bridge links Dandong with Sinuiju, and is three kilometres long.
It was finished in 2014, but only opened on the fifteenth of October.
Chinese analyst Lu Chao says it has resolved a major bottleneck in trade.

scene.quote: The opening of the bridge has resolved a major bottleneck in China-North Korea trade logistics.

lines.text: The visit comes a day before the anniversary of China joining the Korean War.
A South Korean source told Yonhap it will be a very brief visit.

scene.quote: This will be a very brief visit.

lines.text: This week, state media said Kim called for the world's strongest armed forces.
Seoul's spy agency told lawmakers on Friday that rumours of his death were unfounded.
China hosts the APEC summit in Shenzhen next month, and Donald Trump is expected to attend.
Reuters says officials see fading chances of a Trump and Kim meeting this year.
Will Kim meet Trump this year, yes or no?
